label: Quotient MCP Servers (connect an integration)
description: Quotient's MCP Servers settings screen, matched to the real app: settings sidebar (MCP Servers active), a Connected section with green/red/orange status pills, and a Marketplace section with logo rows and chevrons. The 'connect' script action performs the real flow: cursor clicks a marketplace row (e.g. Fathom), an OAuth authorize modal appears, cursor clicks Authorize, and the row's chevron flips to a green Connected pill. Use for 'hook up the integration' beats -- showing Quotient gaining access to a recorder, CRM, or tool.

connected.label: Already-connected rows: {name, domain?, icon_url?, desc, status: 'connected'|'failed'|'pending'}. Defaults to GitHub/Linear/Canva/Attio.

marketplace.label: Marketplace rows: {name, domain?, icon_url?, desc}. Defaults include Fathom (meeting recordings/transcripts).

script.label: Timed actions: connect {service: 'Fathom', at, authorize_after?}. Cursor targets exist per marketplace service (lowercased name) and 'allow'.

show_sidebar.label: Show the settings sidebar (default true -- it replaces the main nav in the real app). Set false when composing inside quotient-app-shell's content region.
